$Comment: Makes Damage_ChargedHit conditional: A conditional damage bonus in whole percent points (10 is +10%) on its holder's charged attacks (an attack whose damage names the Charged class: a held swing, a crossbow's heavy combo bolt). The game classes every shortbow arrow Charged however far the bow was drawn, and a bow's head branch names no class, so this stat cannot tell a full draw from a quick shot: tell those apart by a hit tag on the arrow's damage file, read with the ZigHitTag condition.
